rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption beside or above the cell, or the column header of the NOLCO and Schedule 5 tables. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of the printed option (Yes/No, civil status, filing status, taxpayer type, ATC, tax rate and deduction method, overpayment). Amounts: every amount is a 9-slot comb with no centavo comb, and the writer value is formatted 1,234.00, so no money_joins and the amounts stay blank. The item 1 sheet has only a YYYY comb. Stamped TIN cells keep their catalog name=. Split date combs, the email, the attachment-count boxes and the signature block stay blank.
